pages.text: $(bold)What it does:$(0) forges Akaishi armor into $(4)Life Fusion Armor$(0).$(li)Input: one Akaishi Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings/Boots + one $(4)Life Fusion Ingot$(0)$(li)Costs $(bold)no energy$(0)$(li)The result $(4)keeps every upgrade on the original piece$(0) — active upgrades and free slots carry over intact$(br2)The anvil only accepts the four akaishi pieces; anything else is ignored.

pages.title: Where Fusion Ingots Come From
pages.text: $(bold)One source only$(0): the Life Fusion Ingot has no crafting recipe — it can only be produced by the ritual at the $(l:akaishi:mother_altar)Altar of the Black Mother$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)Four results:$(0) Life Fusion Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings and Boots.$(br2)Ingots are precious — plan which piece to upgrade first. The chestplate usually pays off fastest.

$(bold)Twice the strength:$(0) Life Fusion Armor doubles the base stats of akaishi armor.$(li)Armor (boots/legs/chest/helm) $(4)8 / 14 / 20 / 8$(0), toughness $(4)8$(0), knockback resistance 0.2, enchantability 25$(li)Each piece worn: $(4)+2$(0) gene compatibility across all genes$(li)Full set (4 pieces): organ strength ×1.2, rejection grows ×0.75, damage can be offset by energy from portable cells (100 akaishi per point), and $(4)free flight$(0) — revoked when you take it off or leave creative/spectator mode$(br2)This is the life line's endgame armor — start planning at the Mother Altar.
Stock transplant materials in the Organ Vault, earn fusion ingots at the Mother Altar, then feed your character organs and traits.
